title: Wean Back and Wewax Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Wean Back and Wewax is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 32 ODESSA STREETExperience Seaside, Florida Like Never Before at 32 Odessa StreetExperience the best of the Florida Panhandle at 32 Odessa Street, one of Seaside’s most belovedvacation homes, offering a rare double-lot setting, exceptional outdoor living space, and a premierlocation just 170 from the Odessa Pavilion beach access, a 1 minute walk! Perfectly positioned in the heartof Seaside, FL, this classic beach home sleeps up to 9 guests and delivers a relaxed yet refined Seasidevacation rental experience ideal for families and groups.Prime Location Near the Beach in Seaside, FLLocated just three houses from beach access and a five-minute walk from Seaside’s town center, thishome places guests within easy walking distance of Seaside’s iconic beach pavilions, over 40 shops andrestaurants, and bike paths. Private access to the Odessa Pavilion provides a convenient, uncrowdedentry to Seaside’s sugar-white sand beaches and emerald Gulf waters.It’s rare double lot offers added privacy—an exceptional find so close to the beach and Central Square.Classic Seaside Living with Exceptional Outdoor SpaceWhat truly sets this Seaside, FL beach rental apart is its expansive outdoor living. Guests are welcomedby wraparound furnished porch with Adirondack seating for 10, perfect for morning coffee or eveninggatherings. The private courtyard offers a serene escape, while the charming gazebo features a lightedoutdoor dining table seating 8–10, ideal for shared meals under the glow of evening lights while listeningto the nearby waves.For added family fun, the property includes a basketball goal, offering space to play and unwind after aday at the beach.Comfortable, Light-Filled Interiors Designed for RelaxationStep inside to an inviting open-concept living space that blends coastal comfort with functionality.The main living area features a slipcovered sofa, two club chairs, and double doors opening to anairy porch. Adjacent is a dining area with a farmhouse table for eight, leading to a bonus secondliving room with a large flat-screen TV, built-in cabinetry, a generous sofa, and a curated bookcollection. The renovated kitchen boasts quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a wineand beverage fridge, a double-door Sub-Zero refrigerator, and a central four-burner gas stovetop.Two breakfast bars—one seating three near the dining area and another seating two off the mainliving room—create a welcoming hub for casual meals, coffee, or evening cocktails.Two bedrooms are located on the main level. One includes twin bunk beds plus an additional twin and aprivate full bath, making it perfect for children or extra guests. The second main-level bedroom offers aqueen bed with private access to a hall bath (shower only).Private Upper-Level Retreats & Tower Room ViewsThe second floor is dedicated to the primary king suite with ensuite bath. This bedroom has its own TV, asitting area with table, and dresser. The private bath features a single vanity and a glass enclosed walk inshower with three shower heads. Just off the primary is direct access to a beautifully furnished opendeck—an ideal spot to enjoy coastal breezes.At the top of the home, the third-floor tower room offers a full bed and sweeping panoramic views ofthe Gulf through surrounding windows. (Please note: access to the tower room requires climbing steepstairs and may not be suitable for all guests.)With its unbeatable location, generous lot size, and thoughtfully designed indoor and outdoor spaces, 32Odessa Street stands out among Florida Panhandle vacation rentals, offering a memorable andauthentic Seaside experience.5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Mustbe 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESFeatures 2,296 square feet1-minute, 171-foot walk to beach access at Odessa Pavilion; largest residential private beaches on30AA sauna is located on the property but is not available for guest use.Private side driveway with basketball goalParking for 3 cars in private drivewayOn a double lotPrivate courtyard and gazeboOutdoor diningCharcoal GrillPeacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay & 3 Pickle Ball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOnly 2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.
